spec.net_bp: per decision month: sum over names of (screened - raw) engine contribution x1e4 (E184's own per-month series)
spec.turnover: (names entering + names leaving) / mean(prev,cur) book size, read from the engine's own contribution sink keys, cash pseudo-name excluded
spec.repair_names: how many names the repair's delta dict covers that month -- measured 2026-10-28 to EQUAL the book size in every era (340/340, 791/791), because the screen re-weights every held name rather than adding or dropping one; published as a book-size echo, NOT as a count of the names the repair moved

engine.core: _tilt3signname_burn (the same two arms every name-level leg reads)

honest: membership comes from the contribution sink, i.e. names that carried weight, so a name held at a rounding weight is invisible here
turnover is measured on the screened book only; the raw book's membership is not printed, so a repair that CHANGES membership is inside the churn number, not separated from it
the month net is the repair's own per-month arithmetic, not the engine's month return, so it is gross of the turnover fee

median_repair_names equals median_book_names in every era (340/340, 791/791): the screen re-weights the whole book, so that column is a book-size echo and not a count of moved names -- it is published because it was asked for, with that reading attached
pre2017 and 2017_2020 carry a ZERO repair delta in this reading, so the tie cannot be measured there at all; those eras are published as no_against_months rather than as a passing discount
descriptive census only: no gate, no prereg, no trial count
